bullets.text: US envoys are heading to meet with Ukrainian President Zelensky after talks with Russian President Putin in Moscow, where Putin reportedly agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.

An Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital reportedly killed six Palestinians, according to the health ministry. Witnesses stated a missile hit a building containing surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital.
Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided in Egypt, with President Sisi ordering a prompt investigation into the incident.
An ABC analysis reveals that only a few government ministers have achieved net savings this year, as the government aims for "across the board" savings before the mid-year budget update.
A midwife specializing in homebirths will need to reduce her caseload by half due to a new federal insurance scheme that offers limited coverage for private midwives.
There has been a surge in teen extremism in Australia, with experts noting young people possessing "hard drives full of what can only be described as gore."

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned, causing shares in the chipmaker to slide and raising concerns about the future of the AI industry and its financial dependencies. Colette Kress will take over as interim head.

The US budget deficit widened to $404 billion in October, a 42% increase from the previous year, according to Treasury Department data. This comes as Federal Reserve officials indicate that further interest rate hikes may be necessary to control inflation.
Italy is considering an 'exit tax' on the capital gains of rich emigrants, a move that is causing significant debate and highlights the challenges of implementing such policies.
